EDC v0.3.0-beta.2 lets beta testers send feedback from the app on Android, Windows, and Linux.

## Changes

- Open **Settings → Send feedback** to report a bug or suggest a change. The form sends only the message you enter and works without an account.

## Upgrading

From **EDC v0.3.0-beta.1**, open **Settings → App updates → Check for updates** to install beta.2.

In **EDC v0.2.3**, open **Settings → App updates**, turn on **Include beta updates**, and save. Choose **Check for updates** to install the beta.

If the beta gives you trouble or you’re finished testing, choose **Return to stable** in Settings. On Android, tap **Update** to switch back to v0.2.3 and keep your installed cheats, or **Cancel** to stay on the beta.

## Downloads

- **Android:** [Download APK](https://github.com/ChrisA95G/eden-cheats-manager/releases/download/v0.3.0-beta.2/eden-cheats-manager.apk)
- **Windows x86-64:** [Download EXE](https://github.com/ChrisA95G/eden-cheats-manager/releases/download/v0.3.0-beta.2/Eden.Cheats.Manager_0.3.0-beta.2_x64-setup.exe) or [Download MSI](https://github.com/ChrisA95G/eden-cheats-manager/releases/download/v0.3.0-beta.2/Eden.Cheats.Manager_0.3.0-beta.2_x64_en-US.msi)
- **Linux x86-64:** [Download AppImage](https://github.com/ChrisA95G/eden-cheats-manager/releases/download/v0.3.0-beta.2/Eden.Cheats.Manager_0.3.0-beta.2_amd64.AppImage) — make it executable with `chmod +x`, then run it.

[Setup guide](https://github.com/ChrisA95G/eden-cheats-manager/blob/v0.3.0-beta.2/README.md#quick-start)

Windows installers are not publisher-signed and may show a platform security warning. Android may ask you to allow installs from EDC. Back up existing cheats and settings before updating.

`SHA256SUMS` contains the download checksums. EDC uses `latest.json` for desktop updates and `eden-cheats-manager-stable-0.2.3.apk` to return to stable on Android.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/ChrisA95G/eden-cheats-manager/compare/v0.3.0-beta.1...v0.3.0-beta.2
